item.title: A place for research notes
item.description:
FORGE stands for Frontier Offensive Research & Generative Exploitation, part of Microsoft Security.

This blog provides a home for public research notes alongside the lab’s public repository.

Public findings

The repository maintains a cumulative CVE dataset, updated as findings are cleared for public disclosure.

Responsible disclosure

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues. Follow the reporting guidance in the repository’s security policy.
